title: FINNY Named a 2026 InvestmentNews 5-Star Technology Winner
summary: FINNY has been named a winner of the 2026 InvestmentNews 5-Star Technology awards, which recognize the best new technology and software for investment management professionals.
body_markdown:
FINNY has been named a winner of the[2026 InvestmentNews 5-Star Technology awards](https://www.investmentnews.com/best-in-wealth/best-new-technology-and-software-for-investment-management-professionals/267881) , which recognize the best new technology and software for investment management professionals.


Now in their third year, the awards invite technology providers from across the United States to submit their solutions and explain how they address the challenges wealth management professionals face. The InvestmentNews team evaluates each entry on the quality and depth of information provided, the level of genuine innovation and the value it brings to the industry, benchmarking submissions against one another to pick the top performers.


The recognition comes days after FINNY’s Hunter Growth Agent[won the 2026 Wealthie for AI Marketing and Lead Generation](https://finny.com/blog/finny-wins-the-2026-wealthie-for-ai-marketing-and-lead-generation) .


Thank you to InvestmentNews for the recognition, and congratulations to this year’s other winners.
